summary: Modularize conformance and harden symlink traversal, JSON bounds, and intent secret/control checks

delivery.outcome: Move resolve, validate_request, and validate_state into standard/twin_primitives.py (re-exported from standard/conformance.py) so conformance.py drops well below 500 lines, harden has_symlink_ancestor against relative and un-normalized symlink-parent traversal, bound JSON integer digits before int() conversion, scan blueprint intent for secret material and control characters, enforce allow_nan=False in CLI output, expand test_twin_hardening.py, and mark merged ticket-019 DONE.
nonGoals: Do not modify vendored standard/lifecycle*.py or frozen schema/grammar/profile/blueprint digests

architecture.decision: Rebalance request/state validators into standard/twin_primitives.py with full re-exports in standard/conformance.py while hardening symlink-ancestor, JSON integer digit, and blueprint/stage intent validation in standard/twin_io.py.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket branch commit via protected PR delivery.
